summary: Request a new access token from the identity the edge authenticated
description: Signs in through Authentik forward auth. The request must carry the identity headers the outpost injects (X-authentik-email, X-authentik-groups, ...) plus the shared secret the edge adds, and the identity must be a member of AUTH_SSO_REQUIRED_GROUP. No body is sent: the credential is the gateway's session, not a password.

403.description: The request did not come from the edge, carried no identity, or the identity is not in the required group
